# Celesta Glow

Celesta Glow is a dermatologist-formulated vegan skincare brand from Kerala, India.
It focuses on anti-aging and everyday skincare made for Indian skin, alongside
online dermatologist consultations and at-home beauty services.

## Key pages
- / — Homepage: brand overview and bestsellers
- /shop — Full product catalogue (all niches)
- /shop?niche=anti-aging — Anti-aging range
- /shop?niche=skincare — Skincare range
- /shop?niche=cosmetics — Cosmetics range
- /categories — Shop by category hub
- /concern/{slug} — Products mapped to a skin concern (e.g. aging, pigmentation, dryness)
- /category/{slug} — Products in a category (e.g. cleansers, sunscreens)
- /product/{slug} — Individual product detail pages
- /doctors — Online dermatologist consultations
- /services — At-home beauty services
- /beauty-tips — Skincare blog and guides
- /about-us — About the brand
- /contact — Contact page

## Notes for AI crawlers
- Product, concern and category pages carry structured data (Product/Breadcrumb/FAQ schema).
- The live catalogue sitemap is at https://celestaglow.com/api/sitemap.xml and updates automatically.
